Get VTB Infobasket Box Score

Source: R/vtb.R
vtb_infobasket_box_score.Rd

Player box score of a finished game (one row per player of each team, DNPs included).

Endpoint: GET https://org.infobasket.su/Widget/GetOnline/{game_id}

Usage

vtb_infobasket_box_score(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

Infobasket GameID (game_id in vtb_infobasket_calendar; the v2 matches' match_id), e.g. 921391. Global across seasons.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player box score of a finished game (one row per player of each team, DNPs included). The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py vtb_infobasket_box_score); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerInfobasket GameID of the game (the v2 matches' match_id); global across seasons.
team_idintegerInfobasket TeamID (2650 = Lokomotiv Kuban); the v2 teamId. Not a club-record id and not a registration id.
is_homelogicalTrue for team 1, the team listed first (team A, the home side in the calendar); the body has no explicit home flag (unverified).
person_idintegerInfobasket person id (PersonID): one person (player, coach or official) across clubs and seasons. Joins to /Widget/PlayerPage/{personId} (players) and /Widget/CoachPage/{personId} (coaches).
team_numberintegerSide of the player's team: 1 team A (home), 2 team B (away).
player_numberintegerShirt number as an integer (-1 when none).
display_numbercharacterShirt number as displayed ('0' and '00' differ).
last_name_rucharacterLast name in Russian.
last_name_encharacterLast name in English.
first_name_rucharacterFirst name in Russian.
first_name_encharacterFirst name in English.
person_name_rucharacterName 'Last First' in Russian.
person_name_encharacterName 'Last First' in English.
is_captainlogical1 for the team captain, else 0.
birth_datecharacterBirth date (ISO 8601 date) of a player: public bio, kept; coaches' and officials' birth data is never output.
pos_idintegerPosition code: players 1 point guard, 2 shooting guard, 3 small forward, 4 power forward, 5 centre; coaches 1000 head coach, 1001 assistant; officials 101-103 referees, 104 commissioner, 111-123 table officials (exact roles unverified).
country_code_ioccharacterNationality code: ISO 3166 alpha-2 in most rows ('RU', 'US'), IOC alpha-3 in some ('BLR').
country_name_rucharacterNationality code (same as CountryCodeIOC), not a name.
country_name_encharacterNationality code (same as CountryCodeIOC), not a name.
rank_rucharacterSporting title, Russian; empty or null in the samples.
rank_encharacterSporting title, English; empty or null in the samples.
heightintegerHeight in centimetres.
weightintegerWeight in kilograms.
pointsintegerPoints. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
shot1integerFree throws attempted. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
goal1integerFree throws made. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
shot1_percentdoubleFree-throw percentage (0-100); parsed to a number (the wire sends a comma-decimal string, null when there were no attempts).
shot2integer2-point field goals attempted. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
goal2integer2-point field goals made. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
shot2_percentdouble2-point percentage (0-100); parsed to a number (the wire sends a comma-decimal string, null when there were no attempts).
shot3integer3-point field goals attempted. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
goal3integer3-point field goals made. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
shot3_percentdouble3-point percentage (0-100); parsed to a number (the wire sends a comma-decimal string, null when there were no attempts).
assistintegerAssists. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
blocksintegerBlocked shots. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
def_reboundintegerDefensive rebounds. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
off_reboundintegerOffensive rebounds. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
reboundintegerTotal rebounds. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
stealintegerSteals. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
turnoverintegerTurnovers. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
foulintegerPersonal fouls committed. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
opponent_foulintegerFouls drawn. The wire's null is 0 here (null counts are filled).
plus_minusintegerPlus-minus: point differential while on the court. Null where the host sends none.
secondsintegerPlaying time in seconds.
played_timecharacterPlaying time as 'minutes:seconds' (team rows sum the five players: '200:00' = 40 minutes x 5).
is_startlogicalTrue for a starter.
start_markcharacter'+' for a starter, else empty.

Details

  • Owner flag (sdv-internal-refs/vtb/README.md): the VTB United League is run from Russia and several clubs are owned or sponsored by sanctioned state companies (the KHL precedent); Infobasket is the Russian basketball federation's stats platform. Fetching on your own machine is fine. The owner has approved published data releases (2026-10-17), though none is scheduled yet. No accounts or payments are involved.

  • Unofficial and unsupported: both hosts are keyless public JSON backends of vtb-league.com. No terms of use are published; robots.txt is a 404 on api.vtb-league.com and org.infobasket.su (no rules; vtb-league.com disallows only /wp/wp-admin/). The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included, and honours Retry-After on 429 / 503. No key, cookie or proxy is used (live-verified direct from the droplet 2026-10-12).

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26) on both backends. Infobasket keys everything by competition id: vtb_infobasket_seasons maps the END year to the season-level CompID, and the season-keyed wrappers do that mapping for you. CompID means three things: a season (50714), a stage below it (50720 regular season, 54281 playoff; stage-level wrappers take the stage id from vtb_infobasket_comp_issue) and, in the player season stats, an END year.

  • Ids: the v2 matchId is the Infobasket GameID, the v2 teamId the Infobasket TeamID and the v2 venueId the Infobasket ArenaId. team_id is the key on every team route; comp_team_id (a registration in one stage) and the club-record id of the team page are other key spaces. person_id is one person across clubs and seasons.

  • Errors are HTTP 200: an unknown id answers {MessageType, Message}, an unknown game the string 'BadRequest'; both are hoopR_asset_fetch (a failed fetch), never an empty frame. A body for another game, person, team, competition or season than the one asked for is hoopR_asset_fetch too, as is a game that is not final (box score, plays and header need GameStatus 1) and a partial GetTeamStats page. An empty list is hoopR_no_data.

  • Coverage: calendars and box scores from 2009-10; play-by-play and shot x/y from 2022-23 only (earlier games give an empty pbp frame), officials in the line-ups from 2022-23. Shot x/y are decimetres from the basket centre (orientation unverified). Counting statistics are null instead of 0 on the wire (the parsers fill 0), percentages and averages are comma-decimal strings (the parsers return floats), the paint statistics are broken and dropped, and dates come in three encodings (the parsers return ISO strings; .NET instants as Moscow time with its +03:00 offset).

  • Personal data: the runtime removes licence numbers, contact and operator-account fields for everyone and the birth dates, birth years and ages of coaches, referees and other officials from every body. Players' public bio (birth date, height, weight, nationality) is kept.

  • Other tags (vtbyouth, wbc, wpremier, rfb) answer through the tag argument; only vtb was captured. The team routes key on the END-year season (sdv-py also lets a caller pass a stage CompID through params; the R wrappers do not).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or the host has nothing for the request: an empty list, a v2 season with no rows, a season without team totals), hoopR_bad_request (a malformed id or league slug, a lang other than en or ru, or a season the competition tag does not have) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx, an empty or non-JSON body, an error envelope or string, a game that is not final or a stub, a partial or possibly truncated page, or a body for another game, person, team, competition, league or season). HTTP 500 is retried (neither host answers 500 for an unknown id). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
